items.title: The CARE Hub
body: In 2024–2025, the CARE Hub provided over 53,000 pounds of food, about 35,300 meals, to more than 9,000 people.
Students who use its resources have a 13% higher retention rate than the university average.
items._source: UVU 2024–2025 Annual Report, p. 19; EverGREEN Campaign Report (v8), p. 23
